featured_reviews.name: Bhav Narwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am so grateful to Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal for giving me back my smile and confidence. I had a very complicated case of two missing front teeth due to a traffic accident when I was 11 years old. I had tried many treatments in Hong Kong, but none of them worked and I was left with dentures that would fall out easily. I was very unhappy and insecure about my appearance and it affected my life in many ways.

When I came to India, I consulted Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal at Sure Smile Dental Clinic in Mumbai. They were very compassionate and professional and took up the challenge of solving my case. They devised a customized plan for me that involved Invisalign, gum surgery, and capping. They were very meticulous and attentive to every detail and made sure that I was comfortable and satisfied throughout the process. What amazed me is through surgery, they were able to create a strong base for my new caps where before they started, there was nothing present! They even painted the inside of the Invisalign sets to make it look like I had a tooth there, which was a very thoughtful touch.

The result was amazing. I now have fully aligned, beautiful, and strong teeth that look natural and feel great. I can smile without any hesitation and I feel more confident and happy. The best part is that they were able to think out of the box and the treatment did not cost me a fortune like it would have in Hong Kong. I am so impressed by the skill and creativity of Dr. Maitreyee and Dr. Vishaal and I highly recommend them to anyone who needs dental care. They are truly the best dentists I have ever met and I am so thankful to them for changing my life. 🙏🏻😊

featured_reviews.name: Bratati Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Doctors Vishal and Maitreyee Dhanjani are some of the best in town! I initially consulted them for an Invisalign routine, and the results 1.5 years later were amazing! Exactly what I had hoped for. My extractions were completely painless and the clinic followed up on call to check on post extraction complications as well. Dr Maitreyee even added a composite retainer to a broken incisor I've had for decades now, and  fixed my root canal cap fit perfectly, something I've struggled to get right despite many dental consultations earlier. Fully recommend them for any orthodontic or dental procedures/consultations in Mumbai.

It’s clear now—you come across as nothing more than a commercial dentist. A clinic, especially in your profession, should be treated with dedication and integrity, not as a space to display ego or aggression. I’m genuinely disappointed by your behaviour and the tone in which you chose to speak.

As for the timing with Dr. Sudha, I was present well before my appointment time, yet the procedure took unusually long—your receptionists can confirm that. Let’s also not forget I was made to wait over two hours during my very first consultation with you. So for you to cancel the scan—despite being available—due to a delay caused by your own team, and then place the blame on me as the patient, is not just unprofessional, it’s unacceptable. And now you’re conveniently trying to twist the narrative?

Says a lot, really.

A lot of people keep postponing smile treatments even when they’ve been unhappy with their teeth for years. Sometimes it’s uneven teeth, small gaps, stains, or simply not liking how their smile looks in photos.
But the hesitation usually comes from one thought — “What if I don’t like the final result?”
That’s where Digital Smile Design makes things easier.
Before starting the treatment, patients can actually see a preview of how their smile may look afterwards. Dentists use photos, scans, and smile analysis to plan changes that suit the person’s face and natural features.
People searching for a dentist near me often worry that cosmetic dental treatments will look too artificial. Seeing the smile beforehand usually makes patients feel more relaxed because they know what to expect.
Patients visiting a dentist in Khar West often choose Digital Smile Design before veneers, smile makeovers, or teeth correction treatments because they want more clarity before starting.
Many people also visit a dentist in Bandra West after years of hiding their smile in pictures or covering their mouth while laughing.
Most patients are not trying to look completely different. They usually just want to smile more confidently without thinking about it so much.

One of the first things people ask when they start looking into dental implants is the cost. And honestly, it makes sense — most patients want to understand what they’re paying for before starting treatment.
The thing is, implant treatment isn’t exactly the same for everyone, which is why the pricing can vary.
For some people, placing the implant is fairly simple. Others may first need treatments like tooth removal, bone grafting, or gum treatment before the implant can be placed safely.
The type of implant used also changes the cost. Some implants are chosen because they’re known for long-term durability, while some cases may need more complex planning depending on the condition of the jawbone and surrounding teeth.
A lot of people searching for a dentist near me are usually trying to figure out whether implants are actually worth it in the long run. Most patients choose them because they feel stable, natural, and much closer to real teeth during everyday life.
Patients visiting a dentist in Bandra West also often notice that implant costs differ between clinics. Usually, things like the dentist’s experience, technology used, materials, and treatment planning all play a role.
Many people also visit a dentist in Khar West for dental implant consultations after struggling with missing teeth or difficulty chewing comfortably.
For most patients, the decision usually comes down to comfort, long-term reliability, and what feels practical for daily life.

A lot of people looking into dental implants are surprised when the dentist mentions something called bone grafting first.
Usually the next question is — “Why do I need that if I’m only replacing a tooth?”
The reason is simple. Dental implants need enough healthy jawbone support to stay stable long-term. When a tooth has been missing for a long time, the bone in that area can slowly shrink over time because it’s no longer being used.
That’s where bone grafting helps.
The procedure helps rebuild or strengthen the bone before placing the implant. It gives the implant better support and improves the chances of long-term success.
Many patients searching for a dentist near me worry that bone grafting sounds painful or complicated. But honestly, most people say the idea of it feels scarier than the actual procedure itself.
Patients visiting a dentist in Khar West often need bone grafting after losing a tooth years earlier or after long-term dental infections that affected the surrounding bone.
Many people also visit a dentist in Bandra West for dental implants and related procedures after being told they don’t currently have enough bone support for the implant.
In most cases, bone grafting is simply an extra step to help make the implant stronger and more stable in the long run.

Most people don’t treat a broken tooth like an emergency at first. If the pain isn’t severe, they usually continue with their routine and assume they’ll get it checked eventually.
But broken teeth have a way of getting worse quietly.
In the beginning, it might just feel odd while chewing. Maybe cold drinks suddenly sting a little, or food keeps getting stuck around that tooth more than before. Since the discomfort comes and goes, people often ignore it longer than they should.
That’s usually when the search for a dentist near me finally happens.
If the tooth is checked early, the fix is often simpler — sometimes just a filling or crown is enough. But when the crack reaches deeper inside, treatments like root canal treatment may be needed to save the tooth.
A lot of patients visiting a dentist in Khar West mention the same thing — they delayed treatment because it didn’t hurt constantly in the beginning. Unfortunately, teeth don’t really repair themselves once they crack.
Many people also visit a dentist in Bandra West for broken teeth caused by hard foods, old fillings, cavities, or sudden accidents while eating.
In most situations, treating it early is far easier than waiting for the pain to become impossible to ignore.

A lot of people think losing teeth or struggling to chew properly is just a part of getting older. So many senior citizens slowly adjust to discomfort over the years without realizing how much it affects everyday life.
Eating becomes difficult, certain foods get avoided completely, and even smiling confidently starts feeling different after a point.
That’s usually when families begin looking into treatments like full mouth rehabilitation.
Full mouth rehabilitation is not one single treatment. It’s a combination of dental procedures planned together to improve comfort, chewing, and overall oral health. Depending on the condition of the teeth and gums, it may include dental implants, crowns, bridges, dentures, or other restorative treatments.
Many families searching for a dentist near me are mainly looking for a solution that helps senior citizens eat comfortably and feel confident again.
Patients visiting a dentist in Khar West often ask whether these treatments are safe for older adults. In most cases, yes — the treatment plan is always customized according to the person’s oral health, comfort, and overall condition.
A lot of families also visit a dentist in Bandra West for full mouth rehabilitation after years of missing teeth, worn teeth, or difficulty managing dentures comfortably.

Most people don’t really think about dental crowns until a dentist says they need one. It usually happens after a root canal, a cracked tooth, or when a filling stops holding the tooth properly.
And naturally, the next question is — “How long will it last?”
The truth is, crowns can stay in good condition for many years. But small daily habits matter more than people realize. Grinding teeth, chewing very hard foods all the time, or avoiding dental checkups can slowly affect the crown over time.
A lot of patients searching for dental crowns near me also wonder if the crown will feel strange. But once it’s fitted properly, most people adjust to it very quickly. After a while, they stop noticing it during daily life.
The material used for the crown matters too. Some are made more for strength, while others are chosen because they look more natural with nearby teeth.
If you are looking for a trusted dentist in Khar West, regular dental visits can help maintain both the crown and the surrounding teeth for much longer.
Many patients also visit a dentist in Bandra West for dental crowns after root canal treatment, cracked teeth, or old fillings that are no longer strong enough to support the tooth.

Most people get nervous the moment they hear they might need a root canal. Usually because someone has already told them how painful it is supposed to be. So before the treatment even starts, the fear is already there.
But honestly, root canals today are not as scary as people imagine.
A lot of patients believe root canal treatment is more painful than the tooth problem itself. In reality, most people feel relieved after the treatment because the constant pain and discomfort finally stop.
Another common thing people say is that removing the tooth is easier. But dentists usually try to save the natural tooth whenever possible because eating and chewing feel much more comfortable with your own tooth.
Some people also wait too long because the pain suddenly reduces for a few days. But that usually doesn’t mean the infection is gone. The problem underneath can still slowly become worse.
Many patients searching for a dentist near me walk into the clinic feeling anxious about root canals, but most leave saying they expected it to be much harder than it actually was.
If you are looking for a trusted dentist in Khar West, getting the tooth checked early can help avoid bigger dental problems later.
Many patients also visit a dentist in Bandra West for root canal treatment when tooth pain or sensitivity starts affecting daily routine.

Losing a tooth feels strange in ways people don’t expect. At first, most people think they’ll get used to it. And they do, for a while. They chew from one side, smile a little differently, or avoid certain foods without thinking too much about it. But eventually, it starts bothering them enough to look for solutions like dentures or dental implants in Bandra West.
For a lot of people, dentures are the first option they hear about. They’ve existed for years and still work well for many patients. But not everyone enjoys the feeling of removable teeth. Some people find them uncomfortable while eating or talking, especially after long-term use.
What people like about implants is that they don’t really feel “removable.” Once healed, they feel much more like natural teeth. You don’t take them out at night, and you don’t constantly think about them shifting while eating or speaking.
A lot of people searching for a dentist near me also worry about the procedure itself. Honestly, most patients say they expected it to be much worse than it actually was. The idea sounds scary in the beginning, but the treatment is usually more manageable than people imagine.
Patients visiting a dentist in Khar West often choose implants because they want something that feels stable and long-term. Especially when the missing tooth starts affecting confidence, comfort, or even simple things like eating properly.
In the end, both dentures and implants work — it really depends on what feels right for you

Most parents don’t really plan their child’s first dental visit. It usually happens after the child points at a tooth and says, “It hurts here.” Sometimes they stop eating properly from one side, or suddenly complain while brushing. That’s when parents start searching for a pediatric dentist near me.
But the funny thing is, dentists actually prefer seeing children before any of this starts.
The first visit is usually recommended when the first tooth comes in. Not because there’s a problem, but so the child gets familiar with the place early. When kids grow up seeing the dentist regularly, they’re usually much less scared later.
Parents visiting a dentist in Khar West often ask if baby teeth really need that much care since they fall out anyway. But baby teeth do a lot more than people think. They help children chew comfortably, speak properly, and hold space for adult teeth later on.
Regular checkups also make it easier to catch small issues early — cavities, crooked teeth, or even habits like thumb sucking. Most of these things are easier to manage when noticed early.
A lot of families also visit a dentist in Bandra West for routine pediatric dental visits because dealing with a simple checkup is always easier than dealing with a child’s tooth pain unexpectedly.

Tooth pain has a way of making people finally pick up the phone and book an appointment. But waiting until it hurts is rarely the right call. A lot of dental problems do not announce themselves early, and by the time they do, the treatment needed is usually more involved than it would have been a few months prior.
If a few of them sound familiar, finding a dentist near me and getting a checkup scheduled is a reasonable next step.
Sensitivity that keeps showing up A sting when you drink something cold or bite into something sweet is easy to brush off the first time. But if it keeps happening, it is usually pointing to something, whether that is enamel that has worn down, a cavity that is developing, or a root that is more exposed than it should be.
Gums that bleed when you brush This is something many people quietly normalise and should not. Bleeding gums are one of the earlier signs of gum disease, and that is the stage where it is actually straightforward to manage.
Tooth pain in any form Dull, sharp, constant, or occasional, none of it is normal. Tooth pain does not tend to go away without a reason, and giving it time rarely works in your favour.
Something that looks or feels off Discolouration, a chip, gums that seem to be pulling back, or a sore that has been there longer than it should, these things are worth getting looked at rather than waiting on.
For anyone who already visits a dentist in Khar West on a regular basis, the difference over time is noticeable.
